<onlyinclude><includeonly>[[/doc]]

</includeonly>==Purpose of module==
Render and/or search quotes.

==How to use==

<pre>
{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|tags=your newline-separated tags}}
{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|tags={{PAGENAME}}}}
</pre>

==Examples==
Some regular text
{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|tags=Mat
!Lini
!Nynaeve}}
some more regular text
{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|tags=Lini
!Mat
!Nynaeve}}
{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|tags=Nynaeve
!Lini
!Mat}}
some more regular text

{| class="wikitable"
| Description
| Example

| <pre>{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|quote_width=|tags=Mat}}</pre>
|-
|      {{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|quote_width=|tags=Mat}}
|-
| rowspan=2 | Random quote related to a named character using an alias
| <pre>{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|quote_width=|tags=Nyn}}</pre>
|-
|      {{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|quote_width=|tags=Nyn}}
|-
| rowspan=2 | Random quote related to a named character ''not'' related to another named character
| <pre>{{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|quote_width=|tags=Mat
!Rand}}</pre>
|-
|      {{#invoke:WotQ|random_wot_quote|quote_width=|tags=Mat
!Rand}}
|-
|}
